methodNote: Daily mean station EC; selected scenario minus Business as Usual; subarea mean across paired stations. Adjacent calendar months with the same mean direction are combined. Percent uses each station's full-period Business as Usual mean as denominator.
geographyNote: Subareas are transparent analytical station groupings based on named waterways, coordinates, and contiguous reaches; they are not regulatory boundaries.
